visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark brown hair stands on an outdoor rooftop or balcony. She is viewed from behind, looking back over her shoulder with a gentle smile. She wears a white scalloped-edge one-shoulder crop top and matching high-waisted white leggings. A bulky white puffer jacket with a large fur-lined hood is draped loosely off her shoulders. The background consists of urban residential buildings under a gray, overcast sky. (2) She turns to face the camera more directly, posing with one hand raised to her hair. Her expression is confident and playful. The camera captures her from the waist up, highlighting the contrast between the fitted athletic wear and the oversized winter jacket. The lighting is soft and natural, typical of a cloudy day. (3) The scene cuts to her wearing the fur hood of the jacket. She pulls the sides of the jacket toward her face, smiling warmly and looking directly into the lens. This close-up shot emphasizes her facial features and the texture of the ivory-colored fur. The gray tile wall of the balcony remains visible behind her. (4) She transitions back to holding the jacket open, posing with her back to the camera again while glancing over her shoulder with different playful expressions. She makes a small heart gesture with her hands near her face. The editing uses straight cuts to show various angles of the outfit and her poses against the city skyline.
